fullTextZH: 我给大家介绍了在上海出行和在河南出行的区别，
fullTextEN: I introduced to everyone the differences between traveling in Shanghai and Henan,

fullTextZH: 在这个视频里我想给大家介绍一下在上海穿搭和在河南穿搭的区别，
fullTextEN: In this video, I want to introduce to everyone the differences in fashion between Shanghai and Henan,

fullTextZH: 穿搭就是穿衣服和搭配，

fullTextEN: First, everyone look at this photo,

fullTextZH: 我穿着一件黑色的 t 恤，
fullTextEN: I am wearing a black T-shirt,

fullTextZH: 脚上穿着一双粉色的拖鞋，
fullTextEN: Wearing a pair of pink slippers on my feet,

fullTextZH: 头上包着一条绿色的毛巾，
fullTextEN: With a green towel wrapped on my head,
Because I'm about to go to sleep,

fullTextZH: 所以我的脸上敷了一层绿色的面膜。
fullTextEN: so I applied a layer of green face mask on my face.

fullTextZH: 你们觉得像不像绿巨人浩克呢？
fullTextEN: Do you think I look like the Hulk?

fullTextZH: 这个就是我在河南最经常的打扮。
fullTextEN: This is my most common outfit in Henan.

fullTextZH: 因为我身边的年轻人变少了，
fullTextEN: because there are fewer young people around me,
and like to wear more comfortable clothes,

fullTextZH: 所以在夏天我一般穿大裤衩和大 t 恤，
fullTextEN: so in summer I usually wear big shorts and a big T-shirt,
Because I don't go out often,

fullTextZH: 我在河南的朋友也很少化妆，
fullTextEN: my friends in Henan also rarely wear makeup,
because none of us wear makeup,
so we all look the same,

fullTextZH: 那我出门会戴项链、手链、耳环吗？
fullTextEN: So, do I wear necklaces, bracelets, and earrings when I go out?

fullTextZH: 这些东西我有的时候戴，
这张照片是我在上海的学校里面拍的，
fullTextEN: This photo was taken at my school in Shanghai,

fullTextZH: 我上身穿了一件白色的衬衫，
fullTextEN: I was wearing a white shirt on top,

fullTextZH: 下身穿了一条红色的裙子，
fullTextEN: I was wearing a red skirt on the bottom,

fullTextZH: 脖子上还系了一个领带，
fullTextEN: I also tied a tie around my neck,

fullTextZH: 我的耳朵上戴了珍珠耳环，
fullTextEN: I wore pearl earrings on my ears,
When I was living in Shanghai,
There were many young people around me,
Because I was living at school,

fullTextZH: 所以身边会有很多年轻人和同龄人。
fullTextEN: So there were many young people and peers around.

fullTextZH: 同龄人就是年纪跟我差不多大的人，
fullTextEN: Peers are people who are about the same age as me,

fullTextZH: 比如我的同学和我的室友，
fullTextEN: like my classmates and my roommates,
we often go out to have fun together,

fullTextZH: 并且会拍很多很多的照片，
fullTextEN: and we take lots and lots of photos,

fullTextZH: 所以我出门会收拾的漂漂亮亮的，
fullTextEN: so when I go out, I dress up nicely,
and I also put on makeup.

fullTextZH: 化妆会让我的皮肤看起来更好，
fullTextEN: Makeup makes my skin look better,

fullTextZH: 我还会带上项链、手链、耳环等饰品啊，
fullTextEN: I also wear necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and other accessories,

fullTextZH: 在上海我出门的时候一般会穿吊带和短裤，
fullTextEN: when I go out in Shanghai, I usually wear tank tops and shorts,

fullTextZH: 会看到很多非常漂亮的年轻人，
fullTextEN: you will see many very beautiful young people,

fullTextZH: 所以我也会注意自己的穿搭。
fullTextEN: so I also pay attention to my outfits.

fullTextZH: 所以你们看我的穿搭是一件白色的 t 恤，
fullTextEN: So you see my outfit is a white t-shirt,

fullTextZH: 一条牛仔裤和一双黄色的拖鞋。
fullTextEN: a pair of jeans and a pair of yellow slippers.

fullTextZH: 你是更喜欢哪种穿搭呢？
请在评论区留言告诉我吧，
fullTextEN: Please leave a comment and let me know,
See you in the next video.
